description: Executable package workflows using canonical engine text codecs and Web Streams. Run with scripts/project_compat_runner.py --corpus fixtures/compatibility/projects/text_streams.corpus.json. Hand-authored projects, not third-party npm certification.

cases.description: A CommonJS package encodes split UTF-16 chunks once, fans out shared bytes to a file and a decoder, and awaits both sink closes before completion.

files.node_modules/fixture-text-export/index.c: const web=require('node:stream/web');const fs=require('node:fs');module.exports=async function(){const source=web.ReadableStream.from(['A','\ud83d','','\ude00','é','\ud800','\n']);const [raw,text]=source.pipeThrough(new web.TextEncoderStream()).tee();function sink(path){return new web.WritableStream({start(){fs.writeFileSync(path,'');},async write(chunk){await Promise.resolve();fs.appendFileSync(path,chunk);},async close(){await Promise.resolve();fs.writeFileSync(path+'.complete','closed\n');}});}await Promise.all([raw.pipeTo(sink('raw.txt')),text.pipeThrough(new web.TextDecoderStream()).pipeTo(sink('decoded.txt'))]);};

cases.description: An ESM package reexports the decoder constructor. A consumer decodes one-byte offset views, including a split BOM and multibyte JSON text, before publishing parsed application output.

files.main.mjs: import {ReadableStream,WritableStream} from 'node:stream/web';import {Decoder} from '@fixture/text-codec';import {readFileSync,writeFileSync} from 'node:fs';const input=readFileSync('input.json');function* bytes(){for(let i=0;i<input.length;i++)yield new DataView(input.buffer,input.byteOffset+i,1);}const decoder=new Decoder('UTF8',{fatal:true});const parts=[];ReadableStream.from(bytes()).pipeThrough(decoder).pipeTo(new WritableStream({write(text){parts.push(text);}})).then(()=>{const value=JSON.parse(parts.join(''));writeFileSync('result.json',JSON.stringify(value)+'\n');console.log('TEXT_JSON_COMPLETE',value.answer,value.label,decoder.encoding,decoder.fatal,decoder.ignoreBOM);});

cases.description: A fatal decoder reaches an incomplete UTF-8 character at EOF; the application keeps the prior visible chunk but must abort rather than publish a completion artifact.

files.decode.cjs: const web=require('stream/web');const fs=require('fs');module.exports=async function(){const decoder=new web.TextDecoderStream('utf8',{fatal:true});let aborted;const source=web.ReadableStream.from([new Uint8Array([79,75,10]),new Uint8Array([226,130])]);try{await source.pipeThrough(decoder).pipeTo(new web.WritableStream({write(value){fs.appendFileSync('partial.txt',value);},abort(reason){aborted=reason;fs.writeFileSync('aborted.txt','fatal EOF\n');},close(){fs.writeFileSync('complete.txt','incorrect success');}}));throw Error('fatal error was lost');}catch(error){if(!(error instanceof TypeError)||error!==aborted)throw error;return error===aborted;}};

cases.description: A package holds a write behind readable-side backpressure. Cancellation rejects that accepted write with exact identity without invoking user string conversion or creating its output file.

const {TextEncoderStream}=require('node:stream/web');const fs=require('node:fs');module.exports=async function(){let conversions=0;const encoder=new TextEncoderStream();const writer=encoder.writable.getWriter();const reason={stop:true};const pending=writer.write({toString(){conversions++;fs.writeFileSync('unexpected.txt','conversion should not run');return 'no';}}).then(()=>false,error=>error===reason);await Promise.resolve();await Promise.resolve();const before=conversions;await encoder.readable.cancel(reason);const refused=await pending;writer.releaseLock();return [before,conversions,refused,encoder.writable.locked];};
